title: Equipment vocabulary
description: The entries of vocab/equipment.json. Each entry names one implement and states how it takes external load. A field marked x-vocab: equipment must hold one of the names.

loading.description: How the implement takes external load: plates-per-side is a bar loaded symmetrically with plates on each side; plates-single-end is plates stacked on one post or sleeve; fixed means you pick an implement of a set weight; stack is a pin-selected weight stack; none means no external load. Null when no category fits.
